data.one_liner: Creates Live Photo files for iOS lock screen wallpaper.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to generate a Live Photo from a cover image, optional video or audio, and size parameters. The generated file can be saved to the device and used as a lock‑screen wallpaper on iOS.
use_when: You need to programmatically create Live Photos for iOS lock‑screen wallpapers.
You want a quick way to combine an image with video or audio into a Live Photo.
avoid_when: Your app targets Android only (Live Photo not supported).
You require extensive customization of the Live Photo generation process.
strengths: Supports both video and audio content.
Works as a Flutter plugin for iOS.
weaknesses: No configuration options beyond basic parameters.
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, run flutter pub get, and ensure iOS project has required permissions for media access; no additional native code required beyond the plugin integration.
data.minimal_example:
bool success = await LivePhotoMaker.create(
    coverImage: coverImage!.path,
    imagePath: contentImage?.path,
    voicePath: contentVoice?.path,
    width: movWidth,
    height: movHeight);
